rule: (scripts/plum/co-occurrence.mjs, con_pairs.py) ported to the media set.  Media set: every short with measured video in data/generated/model/composition.json (cutsPerSec present, the definition behind its pairsBothSidesVideo 2,481) that is a settled non-paid row of the training set. Splits, by channel:   held   the encoder's 10 held-out channels (data/generated/model/encoder/holdout.json, the file          scripts/composition/fit.mjs reads), never in any group as anchor, positive or negative   val    training channels carved for variant selection: channels in seeded order, each taken while the          running total stays under 15% of training media, until it reaches 10%; never in any group   train  the rest; the only shorts any group contains Behavioral neighbors, within train only:   co-outlier  same channel, both settled outliers (training-set breakout = 1, ratio at least 3x the               channel median), published within 45 days   co-surge    the text recipe's measured co-surge (co-occurrence.mjs signal bm): both shorts reached               the channel median at a crossing the velocity poller measured (publish + the first of               1/6/24/72 h at which views reached it), in the same ISO week, in the same cluster of the               cluster map (data/plum/map.json) Groups: anchor = every train short with a neighbor; positives = up to 3, co-outlier nearest in time first, then co-surge; negatives = 7 train media shorts drawn at random (seed 20261020), not the anchor

heldOutCheck.rule: every anchor, positive and negative id checked against the held-out and validation channels and the train split
